|ingredients = {{Name|Largemouth Bass|1}}{{Name|Wheat Flour|1}}{{Name|Oil|1}} }} '''Crispy Bass''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. Crispy Bass may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock. [[Jodi]] sells a set of three Crispy Bass in her [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|25|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s. One Crispy Bass may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy |love=Jodi |dislike=Krobus,Leo }} ==Bundles== Crispy Bass is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Tailoring== Crispy Bass is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]].
